projects.name: Multi-tenant CI analytics platform
projects.role: Senior Backend Engineer, then Tech Lead
projects.what_you_did: Owned the ingestion and query platform that processed build and test telemetry for around 400 customer organisations. Moved a single-tenant Django monolith to a multi-tenant service on self-managed Kubernetes, reworked storage around ClickHouse while keeping PostgreSQL for transactional data, ran on-call and wrote the runbooks, introduced OpenTelemetry tracing before cutover, and reduced monthly infrastructure spend by 38%.
numbers: p99 query latency from 4.2 seconds to 380 milliseconds

projects.name: Developer tooling and pre-commit static analysis
projects.what_you_did: Built and maintained the internal linting and pre-commit tooling used across roughly 120 repositories. Wrote custom AST-based rules in Python to catch unsafe database access patterns before review, instrumented rule hit rates so noisy rules could be found and retired, and drove the false-positive rate down over two quarters.

projects.name: Payments reconciliation service
projects.what_you_did: Rebuilt the nightly reconciliation job as an event-driven service. Introduced idempotency keys after a retry storm double-charged 1,900 accounts, designed the idempotent write path and replay tooling, and wrote the postmortem and guardrails that followed.
